contract.note: The plain reading (JEPA/AMI not fixing core LLM failures such as hallucination or reasoning) is fair and ordinary. Since the speaker gave no deadline, the horizon is open. The early-resolution triggers are reasonable.

reviews.rationale: This is an open-horizon forecast. The packet shows no public evaluation of JEPA/AMI systems against core LLM problems, and no decisive event such as the approach being abandoned. Absence of results so far is not confirmation, so the outcome cannot be settled by the evaluation date.
